::: {#landscapes .work-item .reveal}
[For biotech, investors, tech-transfer offices]{.work-meta}

::: {}
### Landscape reports

A map of a field from publications, patents and funding: who is active, where, how fast the field is growing, and where the gaps are.

- Patent landscapes: inventors, applicants, countries, trends
- Research landscapes: topics, leading teams, collaborations
- Partner, competitor and talent scouting

[Typical result: a short report, the cleaned dataset, and a dashboard]{.tag .tag-amber}

**Example:** our [patent landscape of phage therapy](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-024-02493-9), published in *Nature Biotechnology* (2024), and its [open protocol](https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-2537/v1).
:::
:::

::: {#evidence .work-item .reveal}
[For researchers, health agencies, review teams]{.work-meta}

::: {}
### Evidence synthesis and AI-assisted screening

Help with the heavy steps of a review: building the search, removing duplicates, and screening thousands of titles and abstracts.

- Searches across OpenAlex and other open sources
- Screening with two AI models and a clear tie-break rule
- Accuracy checked against a hand-labelled sample, reported openly

[Typical result: a screened set of records, a methods note you can publish]{.tag .tag-amber}
:::
:::

::: {#evaluation .work-item .reveal}
[For funders, universities, research offices]{.work-meta}

::: {}
### Research evaluation and equity analysis

Fair, careful analysis of a research programme or field, using indicators responsibly and always with context.

- Who produces the research, who leads it, who funds it
- Collaboration and leadership patterns, including local leadership in Africa

**Example:** our [Research in Africa](projects/research-in-africa.qmd) programme, including a partner-led study of tick research.
- Evidence for priority setting and grant applications

[Typical result: an evaluation report with clear recommendations]{.tag .tag-amber}
:::
:::

::: {#training .work-item .reveal}
[For research offices, libraries, labs, students]{.work-meta}

::: {}
### Workshops and training

Practical sessions where people learn by doing, on their own topic. In English, and in French on request.

- Mapping a research field with OpenAlex
- AI-assisted screening and how to check it
- Private sessions for teams and institutions

[See the next workshop](workshops.qmd)
:::
:::
